end.summary:
Discussed animals found in soil, including ants, beetles, centipedes, and earthworms.
Practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil.
Practised how soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil.
Pihu continued to say earthworms spoil crops; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised two ways soil animals help: earthworm tunnels let air and water reach roots, and soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil. Pihu named several soil animals and connected tunnels with air reaching roots, but the mix-up that earthworms harm crops was not corrected by the end. At home, look at a plant pot together and draw a tunnel showing air and water entering the soil.
